method: mean Pearson over scan backgrounds per cell type (HepG2, K562), averaged; paired bootstrap over the 58 pieces (both alleles and cell types kept together), seed and draws as src/evaluate_scan.py
note: Scored by src/evaluate_practice.py (files scancheck_<run>*.json/.parquet). Their block 'natural_variants_practice_chromosomes' (chromosomes 6, 13, 20) is NOT valid for model 3: chromosomes 6 and 20 are model-3 training data. Use chr13 (model3_pilots_chr13.json) and this scan check only. The scan's practice half includes 20 of 184 backgrounds on chromosome 7: scan pieces, not the locked natural-variant table (scan neighbours were removed from every part of the model-3 split). Teachers AlphaGenome-FT and MPAC were trained on data that include unchanged versions of most scan pieces, so comparisons with model 2 may favour model 3; comparisons among model-3 students are not affected.
